source_refs.title: What's a verification code and why would someone ask me for it?
source_refs.section: Article body (no subheadings): what scammers ask
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Anyone who asks you for your account verification code is a scammer.
source_refs.model_visible_text: Anyone who asks you for your account verification code is a scammer. Never give your verification code to someone else.
